raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Document the B300 MiniMax-M3.1-Flash AgentX lane of [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4467](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4467) (head `615ee422`, lane `minimaxm31flash-fp4-b300-vllm-agentic-dspark`) as two opt-in B300 presets in `recipes/models/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash.yaml`. The lane runs one aggregated vLLM engine on a single 8-GPU B300 node with image `vllm/vllm-openai:minimax-m31-flash@sha256:86f582dae25ea92802353727164ae4eb03b37b18baf9119b805ffaec2a7ef07c` (vLLM `0.1.dev23341+g8744dd2fb` in the run logs). The recipe has no B300 preset yet, and no open PR covers this lane.

## Claims

Both presets use the default checkpoint, `single_node_tp`, text only (`--language-model-only`), the recipe's Blackwell NVFP4 KV/indexer settings and seven-token DSpark draft, plus the lane's shared settings: `--enable-prefix-caching`, `--max-num-batched-tokens 32768`, `--stream-interval 20`, `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` with an explicit `cudagraph_capture_sizes` list up to 8192, `VLLM_HTTP_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE=600` and `VLLM_CHAT_TEMPLATE_RENDER_TIMEOUT=600`.

**`b300_agentx_tp4` (AgentX TP4, opt-in):** TP4, `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.92`, DSpark draft attention on `FLASH_ATTN` (as qualified; the recipe's NVIDIA default stays `FLASHINFER_TS`). Nine points:

- GPU-resident KV: concurrency 1 / 4 / 8 / 16 / 32 with `--max-num-seqs` 2 / 8 / 16 / 32 / 64.
- Host-DRAM KV offload (the **Simple** KV-offload option, `SimpleCPUOffloadConnector`, `kv_both`, `lazy_offload: true`, `cpu_bytes_to_use: 1499000000000` for the whole engine): concurrency 24 / 40 / 48 / 56 with `--max-num-seqs` 48 / 64 / 64 / 96.

**`b300_agentx_tp2` (AgentX TP2 + KV offload, opt-in):** TP2, `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9`, DSpark draft attention on the recipe's `FLASHINFER_TS`, Simple KV offload with `cpu_bytes_to_use: 749000000000` and `lazy_offload: true` at every point. Concurrency 24 / 32 / 40 / 48 with `--max-num-seqs` 48 / 48 / 60 / 72.

Each preset has a runbook covering host-memory sizing (each rank pins about 349 GiB), the FLASH_ATTN/FLASHINFER_TS split, and the synthetic acceptance the benchmark used. `meta.date_updated` is bumped to 2026-10-27.

## Validation

- `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir <this checkout>/recipes` passes (vllm-project/recipes @ `5790dff`): 217 recipes, JSON API built.
- I built the full JSON API before and after the change. Only MiniMax-M3.1-Flash files change: `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash.json` and its promoted variant `amd/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Quark-MXFP4.json` (each gains `presets` and the new `date_updated`), and `presets/b300_agentx_tp4.json` and `presets/b300_agentx_tp2.json` are added. The B300 baseline rendering does not change, because both presets are opt-in.
- All 13 rendered points match the lane's effective arguments and environment at the PR head (`agentic.yaml` base merged with each point's override) once the exclusions below are removed.
- The rendered TP4 c24 and TP2 c24 commands also match the `vllm serve` commands logged in run [40340506758](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40340506758) (attempt 3), except for the synthetic acceptance settings. In both server logs the connector comes from `--kv-transfer-config` (`SimpleCPUOffloadConnector: ... per_rank=349.01 GB, world_size=4, mode=lazy` and `per_rank=348.78 GB, world_size=2`), confirming that `cpu_bytes_to_use` is the budget for the whole engine. The logs also show `FLASH_ATTN` on TP4 and `FLASHINFER_TS` on TP2.

## Details

The schema expresses every serving setting of the lane. TP comes from the preset's `tp`; the host-DRAM tier comes from `select.kv_offload: simple`, with `json_args` on its `--kv-transfer-config` that swap the Simple option's per-rank default (`cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank`) for the lane's engine-wide `cpu_bytes_to_use`, the same pattern as MiniMax-M3's `b200_agentx`. The capture list and the TP4 draft backend are `json_args` edits as well. The lane ran one engine per node; running several TP2 engines on one node is not qualified, and each engine would need its own share of host RAM (noted in the runbook).

Excluded as InferenceX-only or no-op:

- **Benchmark-only settings:** concurrency lists, synthetic acceptance (`rejection_sample_method: synthetic`, `synthetic_acceptance_length: 4.04`, injected by the benchmark; the presets keep block verification), AIPerf settings, `dram-utilization`.
- **Harness plumbing:** `--served-model-name` and the local `/model` path, `--host`/`--port`, `--device-ids` (GPU placement), `--disable-uvicorn-access-log`, `PYTHONUNBUFFERED`, `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S` (the lane is single-engine, with no data-parallel engine wait).
- **Defaults:** `--max-model-len 1048576` equals the checkpoint's `max_position_embeddings`, and the logs report 1,048,576 tokens per request. `--trust-remote-code` is not needed because vLLM registers the `minimax_m3_vl` config itself (`vllm/transformers_utils/config.py`), and the recipe's existing B300 commands, on the same image tag, omit it.
- **`VLLM_USE_SIMPLE_KV_OFFLOAD`:** a no-op here (the lane sets `1` on its offload points and `0` on the resident ones). vLLM reads it only in `VllmConfig._post_init_kv_transfer_config`, to choose the connector when `--kv-offloading-size` is set (`vllm/config/vllm.py` on `main`). The lane never sets `--kv-offloading-size` (absent from the logged non-default args) and passes the connector explicitly. The pinned build's commit `8744dd2fb` is not in this repository, so this is checked against `main` and against the logged connector creation.

---

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.

</details>

   description: "MiniMax M3.1-Flash vision-language MoE (~428B total / 23B active) with MSA sparse attention throughout and a built-in DSpark draft; quantization-aware trained, MXFP8 dense layers and NVFP4 experts. Served TP4 on NVIDIA Blackwell or AMD MI355X, prefill/decode disaggregated as TP4 + TP4 on MI355X or DEP2 + DEP4 on GB200/GB300, and TP8 on NVIDIA Hopper."
   date_added: 2026-10-23
-  date_updated: 2026-10-23
+  date_updated: 2026-10-27
   tasks:
     - text
     - multimodal
@@ -377,6 +377,117 @@ strategy_overrides:
             CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: "0,1,2,3"
             VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT: "BLHNC"
 
+presets:
+  b300_agentx_tp4:
+    label: "AgentX TP4"
+    hardware: b300
+    strategy: single_node_tp
+    variants: [default]
+    workload: "Agentic (InferenceX AgentX)"
+    description: "One TP4 engine on four of the node's eight B300 GPUs with the seven-token DSpark draft on FLASH_ATTN; GPU-resident KV up to concurrency 32, host-DRAM KV offload (about 1.5 TB per engine) at 24 and 40-56."
+    source: { label: "InferenceX #4467", href: "https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4467", key: "minimaxm31flash-fp4-b300-vllm-agentic-dspark", revision: 615ee422fa655b90a0551e7fe80230f543f57a10 }
+    image: "vllm/vllm-openai:minimax-m31-flash@sha256:86f582dae25ea92802353727164ae4eb03b37b18baf9119b805ffaec2a7ef07c"
+    tp: 4
+    select:
+      features: { text_only: true }
+    args:
+      - "--enable-prefix-caching"
+      - "--gpu-memory-utilization"
+      - "0.92"
+      - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+      - "32768"
+      - "--stream-interval"
+      - "20"
+    env:
+      VLLM_HTTP_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE: "600"
+      VLLM_CHAT_TEMPLATE_RENDER_TIMEOUT: "600"
+    json_args:
+      "--compilation-config": { cudagraph_capture_sizes: [8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 72, 80, 88, 96, 104, 112, 120, 128, 136, 144, 152, 160, 168, 176, 184, 192, 200, 208, 216, 224, 232, 240, 248, 256, 320, 384, 448, 512, 576, 640, 704, 768, 832, 896, 960, 1024, 1536, 2048, 3072, 4096, 6144, 8192] }
+      "--speculative-config": { attention_backend: "FLASH_ATTN" }
+    # cpu_bytes_to_use is the engine-wide host budget (split across the TP
+    # ranks); the Simple option's per-rank default is dropped.
+    points:
+      c1: { label: "1", concurrency: 1, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "2"], select: { kv_offload: "off" } }
+      c4: { label: "4", concurrency: 4, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "8"], select: { kv_offload: "off" } }
+      c8: { label: "8", concurrency: 8, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "16"], select: { kv_offload: "off" } }
+      c16: { label: "16", concurrency: 16, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "32"], select: { kv_offload: "off" } }
+      c24:
+        label: "24 (KV offload)"
+        concurrency: 24
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "48"]
+        select: { kv_offload: simple }
+        json_args:
+          "--kv-transfer-config": { kv_connector_extra_config: { cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank: null, cpu_bytes_to_use: 1499000000000, lazy_offload: true } }
+      c32: { label: "32", concurrency: 32, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "64"], select: { kv_offload: "off" } }
+      c40:
+        label: "40 (KV offload)"
+        concurrency: 40
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "64"]
+        select: { kv_offload: simple }
+        json_args:
+          "--kv-transfer-config": { kv_connector_extra_config: { cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank: null, cpu_bytes_to_use: 1499000000000, lazy_offload: true } }
+      c48:
+        label: "48 (KV offload)"
+        concurrency: 48
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "64"]
+        select: { kv_offload: simple }
+        json_args:
+          "--kv-transfer-config": { kv_connector_extra_config: { cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank: null, cpu_bytes_to_use: 1499000000000, lazy_offload: true } }
+      c56:
+        label: "56 (KV offload)"
+        concurrency: 56
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "96"]
+        select: { kv_offload: simple }
+        json_args:
+          "--kv-transfer-config": { kv_connector_extra_config: { cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank: null, cpu_bytes_to_use: 1499000000000, lazy_offload: true } }
+    runbook: |
+      The B300 AgentX lane in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) (`minimaxm31flash-fp4-b300-vllm-agentic-dspark`, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4467](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4467), run [40340506758](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40340506758)) serves the default checkpoint (MXFP8 dense layers, NVFP4 experts, NVFP4 KV and indexer K caches) as one aggregated text-only vLLM engine on a single 8-GPU B300 node. Its TP4 points run the seven-token DSpark draft with `FLASH_ATTN` draft attention; the recipe's NVIDIA default, `FLASHINFER_TS`, is what the [AgentX TP2](#preset-b300_agentx_tp2) points run.
+
+      - **GPU-resident points** (concurrency 1-16 and 32) keep the whole KV cache in HBM, with `--max-num-seqs` at twice the concurrency (64 at 32).
+      - **KV offload points** (24 and 40-56) add a host-DRAM KV tier through `SimpleCPUOffloadConnector` with lazy offload. `cpu_bytes_to_use` (1,499 GB) is the budget for the whole engine: each of the four ranks pins 349 GiB of host memory, so the engine needs about 1.5 TB of free host RAM. Pinning takes a couple of minutes at startup.
+      - The CUDA graph capture sizes go up to 8192 tokens, so prefill chunks of up to 8192 tokens also replay graphs.
+
+      The InferenceX throughput points replaced block verification with synthetic rejection at the committed golden DSpark acceptance length (4.04) so every point is measured at the same acceptance rate. The command above keeps block verification.
+

+    label: "AgentX TP2 + KV offload"
+    hardware: b300
+    strategy: single_node_tp
+    variants: [default]
+    workload: "Agentic (InferenceX AgentX)"
+    description: "One TP2 engine on two of the node's eight B300 GPUs with the seven-token DSpark draft on FLASHINFER_TS and host-DRAM KV offload (about 750 GB per engine)."
+    source: { label: "InferenceX #4467", href: "https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4467", key: "minimaxm31flash-fp4-b300-vllm-agentic-dspark", revision: 615ee422fa655b90a0551e7fe80230f543f57a10 }
+    image: "vllm/vllm-openai:minimax-m31-flash@sha256:86f582dae25ea92802353727164ae4eb03b37b18baf9119b805ffaec2a7ef07c"
+    tp: 2
+    select:
+      features: { text_only: true }
+      kv_offload: simple
+    args:
+      - "--enable-prefix-caching"
+      - "--gpu-memory-utilization"
+      - "0.9"
+      - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+      - "32768"
+      - "--stream-interval"
+      - "20"
+    env:
+      VLLM_HTTP_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE: "600"
+      VLLM_CHAT_TEMPLATE_RENDER_TIMEOUT: "600"
+    json_args:
+      "--compilation-config": { cudagraph_capture_sizes: [8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 72, 80, 88, 96, 104, 112, 120, 128, 136, 144, 152, 160, 168, 176, 184, 192, 200, 208, 216, 224, 232, 240, 248, 256, 320, 384, 448, 512, 576, 640, 704, 768, 832, 896, 960, 1024, 1536, 2048, 3072, 4096, 6144, 8192] }
+      "--kv-transfer-config": { kv_connector_extra_config: { cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank: null, cpu_bytes_to_use: 749000000000, lazy_offload: true } }
+    points:
+      c24: { label: "24", concurrency: 24, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "48"] }
+      c32: { label: "32", concurrency: 32, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "48"] }
+      c40: { label: "40", concurrency: 40, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "60"] }
+      c48: { label: "48", concurrency: 48, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "72"] }
+    runbook: |
+      The TP2 points of the B300 AgentX lane in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) (`minimaxm31flash-fp4-b300-vllm-agentic-dspark`, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4467](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4467), run [40340506758](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40340506758)) serve the default checkpoint as one aggregated text-only vLLM engine on two GPUs of an 8-GPU B300 node, with the recipe's seven-token DSpark draft on `FLASHINFER_TS` (the [AgentX TP4](#preset-b300_agentx_tp4) points use `FLASH_ATTN`).
+

The lane ran one engine per node; several TP2 engines on one node each need their own share of host RAM.
